usedFor: Slack is where your team talks, and Cody.ai stores what matters: “New Message in Channels” feeds “Create Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message in Channels” in Slack, then “Create Document” in Cody.ai
bestTemplate.why: Channel messages become documents in your knowledge base, so answers can draw on what the team said.

watchOut: “New Message in Channels” is polling, so documents appear after a scheduled check and not instantly.
